description: One saved version of the presentation. Its folder, `versions/<time>/`, is named by when it was saved, in UTC to the second with dots for colons, as `versions/2026-10-30T16.20.05Z/`, followed by a dash and four lowercase letters or digits where that name is already taken. The folder holds copies of the presentation's two files as they were saved, `presentation.mdpoint` and `slides.md`, and this file. The folder's name tells versions apart: two computers saving offline can give two versions the same number, and both are kept. MarkdownPoint opens a version from its presentation's Version history, never its folder as a presentation of its own. A version names its theme by key and shows the theme as it is now. It uses the presentation's own media. Delete Theme refuses a theme a version uses, and Clean Up keeps a file one uses. While a version's folder lacks one of its three files or this file can't be read, as while a sync service brings it, no theme can be deleted and Clean Up deletes nothing.

markdownpoint.description: The format version, its major and minor in quotes: "1.0". MarkdownPoint 1.x opens any version 1.x file. A newer major needs a newer MarkdownPoint.

number.description: The number MarkdownPoint shows: one past the highest version's when it was saved, so a version saved after the newest is deleted takes its number again.

created.description: When it was saved, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ.

name.description: The name the author gave it, on one line, not empty, with no tab or other control character, or none when left out.
